Lists your AutoPay subscriptions. Filters travel in the request body, so keep `customer_id` there and out of the URL. The endpoint is a `POST` that only reads.

**Paging.** `limit` and `offset` are accepted in the request body or in the query string, and the query string wins. `next` and `previous` are absolute URLs on your own Ottu domain, and they carry `limit` and `offset` in the **query string**, even though you sent them in the body.

1. Follow them with `POST`, not `GET`. A `GET` returns `405 {"detail": "Method \"GET\" not allowed."}`. Reuse the same headers and API key.
2. The body is optional when you follow a link, because `limit` and `offset` are already in the query string. Resend your filters in the body if you want them applied to that page too.
3. Query parameters win over body parameters. `{"offset": 1}` posted to a URL that ends `?offset=5` returns the page at offset 5.

Each item in `results` has the same attributes as the Subscription object, except `notification_config` and `current_cycle`. For those two, call Retrieve with the item's `id`.


<pre style={{display:"none"}}>{"curl --location 'https://sandbox.ottu.net/b/pbl/v2/subscriptions/' \\\n--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n--header 'Accept: application/json' \\\n--header 'Authorization: Api-Key YOUR_API_KEY' \\\n--data '{\n  \"status\": \"pending_setup\",\n  \"customer_id\": \"string\",\n  \"created_after\": \"2024-07-29\",\n  \"created_before\": \"2024-07-29\",\n  \"limit\": 0,\n  \"offset\": 0\n}'"}</pre>
